encodings: *B64 = RFC 4648 §4 standard base64 WITH "=" padding (tweetnacl-util); *Hex = lowercase hex; *Json / wire = exact UTF-8 string as emitted by JSON.stringify; rng.draws = PRNG draws in call order (see README.md#prng)
notes: LOCAL-ONLY (never crosses devices). Needed only if a native iOS build replaces the RN app in place and must adopt the RN identity backup slot.

mmkvKeyHex = the 32-char hex string stored in Keychain service "com.mrenzo.mmkv.key" (secureStorage.ts). subkey = SHA-512( UTF-8( context + mmkvKeyHex ) )[0:32] — the hex STRING is concatenated, not decoded.
blob = b64( nonce(24) || secretbox( UTF-8( x25519PrivateKey BASE64 STRING ), nonce, subkey ) ) — the plaintext is the base64 text of the key, not the raw 32 bytes.
